server.name: io.github.vriesdemichael/mm-mcp
server.description: Read, search and post in Mattermost as yourself or a bot.
server.title: mm-mcp for Mattermost

environmentVariables.description: Offer the tools that post and change things. Your client's own approval of each call decides, and mm-mcp checks what each change others see states before it acts.
environmentVariables.name: MM_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES

environmentVariables.description: A PEM file of certificate authorities to trust beside your system's, for a Mattermost whose certificate your organisation signed itself. Leave it empty otherwise.
environmentVariables.name: MM_MCP_CA_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Where save_file writes attachments. Leave it empty for your Downloads directory.
environmentVariables.name: MM_MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Your client's own approval of each call decides whether a post or another change others see goes ahead, and mm-mcp checks what each states. Turn this on to have mm-mcp ask you too, through a question your client shows: a convenience where it shows it, not a safeguard, since some clients answer it themselves.
environmentVariables.name: MM_MCP_ELICITATION_OPT_IN

environmentVariables.description: Not with mm-mcp asks as well: marks each tool that changes what others see so that Claude Code asks a person on every call, whatever its permission mode or rules allow. An agent cannot post on its own while it is on.
environmentVariables.name: MM_MCP_FORCE_HUMAN_IN_THE_LOOP_IN_CLAUDE_CODE

environmentVariables.description: Mark every post and edit the model writes with Mattermost's own marker for text written with AI.
environmentVariables.name: MM_MCP_MARK_AI_GENERATED

environmentVariables.description: Where your app shows mm-mcp's views, a post the model proposes as your draft can be posted from the view with Post. Off, the draft waits in Mattermost for you to send.
environmentVariables.name: MM_MCP_POST_FROM_VIEWS

environmentVariables.description: The most one message carrying an attached file as an MCP resource holds, a binary file counted as its base64. MCP sends a resource whole, and a client drops a message past its own limit, 10 MB for clients built on the TypeScript SDK. A larger one is refused, and read_file or save_file reads it instead. 0 is no limit.
environmentVariables.name: MM_MCP_RESOURCE_MAX_MB

environmentVariables.description: A personal access token or a bot token. Where those are switched off, leave it empty after logging in once with mm-mcp login --url <address> in a terminal, which keeps your session in the system's credential store.
environmentVariables.name: MM_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: The address you open Mattermost at, such as https://chat.example.com.
environmentVariables.name: MM_URL

environmentVariables.description: Decisions file, read back on start so a restart keeps today's spend; servers on one file share one budget. Default ~/.spend-guard/ledger.jsonl; off keeps it in memory.

environmentVariables.description: Port of the approval dashboard on 127.0.0.1. 0 picks a free one; off means no dashboard, and payments that need approval are declined.

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a payment waits for your answer before it is declined. Raise it together with your client's tool timeout.
environmentVariables.name: SPEND_GUARD_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Network the mock rail pretends to pay on.
environmentVariables.name: SPEND_GUARD_MOCK_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Agent key for the arc and gateway rails. Testnet keys only.
environmentVariables.name: ARC_PRIVATE_KEY
